Implemented the feature contract in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: Wrapped the list_editable bulk-edit processing in `ModelAdmin.changelist_view` with `transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model))`. The loop that saves each changed form (save_form/save_model/save_related/log_change) now runs inside a single transaction, so any error rolls back all edits instead of leaving the database in a partial state. `transaction` and `router` were already imported at the top of the file.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (admin_changelist) passed — 74 tests ran, 0 failures.
